product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Hillsboro Modern Wingback Living Room Accent Chair With Nailhead Trim, 29"W, Beige
product.description: Streamlined, gently curving "wings" and arms give a refined, modern refresh to the mid-century wingback chair. Hand-applied nailhead trim with brass finish adds an air of sophistication, while the seat cushion is removable for easy cleaning. 29"W x 37''D x 40.5''H Rayon/linen/polyester blend fabric; metal nailhead trim with brass finish; wood legs. A modernized silhouette of the mid-century wingback style with removable seat cushion Assemble in 15 minutes or less. Vacuum or wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
